notes.title: Director's Cut Now Live!
notes.content:
Director's Cut Branch set to Live
[list]
[*] Introduces Local\Remote CO-OP
[*] New content quest, secrets and expanded areas
[*] Overall fidelity and gameplay improvements
[*] Preserves original game with a switch to seamlessly change from the Director's Cut to the Original

notes.title: Free Director's Cut Update Launching Tonight
notes.content:
The Director's Cut is a major update for Collection Quest
Releasing Tonight Completely Free

Includes:
[list]
[*] Expanded Areas

[*] and Secrets to discover
[*] Overall improved game fidelity
